instructions:
## Objective

Internalize a fictional freight company’s policies and executable business rules in a Qwen3-4B adapter.

## Work to perform

The roughly 31,000-token corpus contains document conflicts and changing records. Distill stable knowledge, resolve which revision governs, execute learned rating rules on new inputs, and defer questions requiring live records. The student receives no corpus at evaluation.

## Deliverable

Trained Qwen3-4B adapter.

## Evaluation

242 hidden questions spanning eight groups; development set has 133. Policy, code, composition, revision handling, abstention and security are weighted separately.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
